description: v3 red lava GOO, translucent (artist 2026-09-26 v2: 'red lava instead of rock with lava in it, more lava blob monster'; v3: 'the lava coloring should be see transparent see through otherwise looks fine'). Colours unchanged from v2 (approved). The whole body is molten, so every goo region glows; the glow tiers grade heat across the goo: cooler crimson undersides, hot red-orange body, orange flow patches and ridges, yellow flame tips (crown points, torn-end tufts, head flame licks, drips, the ball's ears), white-hot yellow core at every torn end (the join faces) and on the droplets, glowing eye sockets with dark pupil pits. v3 'alpha' (0-1, Col alpha = glTF COLOR_0.a) makes the goo see-through: the body goo is the most see-through, the hotter tiers read denser, the eye sockets + pupils stay opaque so the face reads. material.alpha multiplies every region (one knob for 'more / less see-through').

goo_cool.note: undersides (smoothed normal pointing down): cooler crimson goo

goo.note: the body: hot red lava slime

goo_hot.note: hotter orange flow patches (smooth mottling) + ridges

flame.note: flame tips: head flame licks, crown points, torn-end tufts, drip bulbs, finger tips, the ball's ears; the ring round each torn end

core.note: white-hot molten core: the torn (join) end faces, the crater, the floating droplets

eye.note: v3: the glowing socket walls sunk into the goo - top glow tier, opaque

pupil.note: v3: the dark pupil pit at the socket floor (no glow: reads as negative space by contrast), opaque
